verdict.rationale: Pandoc's evidence covers single conversions with in-process AST filters and stdin/stdout I/O, but nothing documents a first-party way to define a multi-step job or watched workflow (convert, then optimize, then deliver). Chaining via shell pipes, GitHub Actions, or external tools like unoconv counts only as user workarounds or host-platform capability, and filters are adjacent transformation hooks rather than workflow orchestration.
